newsitem.title: FRANCE: Italy seen issuing 5 bln Ffr 2007 bond - traders.
newsitem.headline: Italy seen issuing 5 bln Ffr 2007 bond - traders.

text.p: The Italian republic was expected to issue about five billion French francs of 2007 Eurobonds, priced at 18 to 19 basis points over equivalent French government bonds, traders said on Tuesday.
Italy said earlier on Tuesday it had awarded a mandate for a French franc long-dated Eurobond issue to CDC Marches and JP Morgan to act as joint bookrunners.
Both banks declined to comment on details of the issue.
However traders said talk, confirmed by fund managers in Paris who had been sounded out by bankers, centred on a three to five-billion franc issue of 10-year bonds.
"Let's be serious, it will be more like five billion francs than three billion, that's the usual size for Italy," one trader said.
